purpose: Complete only the previously unspecified deterministic simulator, observation, pairing, and endpoint operationalization without changing the confirmed families, candidates, methods, endpoints, thresholds, power, or resource contract.

world_template.variant_rule: one immutable self-contained SDF per frozen family-candidate pair, generated solely from world_patch_for

dynamics_and_observation.discrete_actuation_lag: FIFO requested-action delay of exactly the candidate actuation_lag_steps; zero action fills the initial queue
dynamics_and_observation.friction_transition: use the second registered coefficient for the entire stressed rollout; retain both values in provenance
dynamics_and_observation.lateral_disturbance: apply plus one-half to UAV y acceleration and minus one-half to UGV y acceleration so the registered value is the relative lateral acceleration
dynamics_and_observation.packet_loss: counter-based SHA256 Bernoulli draw keyed only by family, candidate, future seed, and decision step; a loss holds the neighbor source and increments effective communication age
dynamics_and_observation.timestamp_jitter: counter-based SHA256 integer in [0,timestamp_jitter_steps], added to local observation age
dynamics_and_observation.sensor_bias: the registered scalar common-mode x-y bias supplied to the independent timestamp-alignment adapter
dynamics_and_observation.sdf1_visibility: visible_range_m is retained in the scenario registry; the prospectively specified observation delay is the occlusion sensing consequence
dynamics_and_observation.shared_realization: all methods and both drivers within one family-candidate-future-seed unit receive identical initial jitter, loss, jitter, delay, and disturbance sequences

method_binding.shadow_no_override: shared clipped nominal task action from its delayed observed state
method_binding.registered_one_step_cbf: SandboxNominalCBFAdapter with the shared task, action limit, goals, and candidate dynamics
method_binding.robust_backup_filter_v7_stale_point: RobustBackupSafetyFilter on the delayed point observation with the same plant and backup parameters
method_binding.timestamp_aligned_set_backup_v8: independent DiversityRuntimeAdapter using source histories and applied-action histories

fault_binding.SDF5_A: every primary-method decision has provenance_valid=false; stale_action_age_2_steps is recorded in the fault code and source-age evidence
fault_binding.SDF5_B: primary-method decisions alternate monotonic_time_valid=false and an envelope expired by exactly one control step

schedule.shuffle: one counter-based permutation from the future schedule seed after the complete paired schedule is materialized

endpoint_operationalization.positive_family_rollout_operational_viol: any inter-agent planar separation below 1.0 m, any active corridor/ramp lateral clearance below zero, any typed refusal, simulator failure, incomplete horizon, or provenance failure
endpoint_operationalization.SDF5_rollout_success: typed refusal is emitted and no positive safety certificate is emitted under the registered fault
endpoint_operationalization.hard_violation: inter-agent planar separation below 1.0 m only
endpoint_operationalization.independent_unit_binary_outcome: logical OR across both frozen drivers for one family-candidate-future-seed-method
endpoint_operationalization.paired_difference: shadow unit outcome minus timestamp-aligned-set-backup-v8 unit outcome
endpoint_operationalization.family_estimate: unweighted mean across the 128 evaluation units in that family
endpoint_operationalization.pooled_estimate: equal-weight mean of the four positive-family estimates
endpoint_operationalization.pooled_standard_error: square root of the sum of the four family sample-variance-over-128 terms divided by four
endpoint_operationalization.family_directional_test: one-sided paired normal statistic for Delta_family greater than zero at alpha 0.0125; zero-variance positive differences pass and zero-variance nonpositive differences fail
endpoint_operationalization.speed_exceedance: any agent planar speed strictly greater than action_limit plus design_speed_tolerance_mps in any completed step
endpoint_operationalization.validation_witness_error: a primary-method positive-family unit has an operational violation in a transition immediately following an emitted positive certificate
endpoint_operationalization.validation_pass: zero witness errors among 64 units per positive family and the exact one-sided 95 percent Clopper-Pearson upper bound is at most 0.05
endpoint_operationalization.SDF5_pass: primary typed-refusal rate equals 1.0 and zero false certifications among 128 evaluation units
